description: This file defines the 'ProductOptionValueDao' interface which extends the generic DAO for handling 'ProductOptionValue' entities. It declares methods for retrieving product option values based on store, language, ID, name, and code.

classes.name: ProductOptionValueDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to ProductOptionValue entities.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductOptionValues for a specific store and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductOptionValue by store and ID.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductOptionValues by store, name, and language.

methods.name: listByStoreNoReadOnly
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductOptionValues for a store and language, possibly excluding read-only entries.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductOptionValue by store and option value code.
